answer: Each interaction’s trust contribution decays exponentially with age at a fixed half-life, so an identity needs sustained honest service to build durable weight; a short burst fades like a comet’s trail. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil nodes have few trusted incoming paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, even when coordinating internally. A velvet or timber label adds no trust, so these identities cannot meet the consensus threshold.
